bible_verses.telugu: నా ప్రాణమా, యెహోవాను సన్నుతించుము. నా అంతరంగముననున్న సమస్తమా, ఆయన పరిశుద్ధ నామమును సన్నుతించుము.
bible_verses.english: Praise the Lord, my soul; all my inmost being, praise his holy name.

bible_verses.telugu: నీవు నీ పూర్ణహృదయముతోను, నీ పూర్ణాత్మతోను, నీ పూర్ణవివేకముతోను, నీ పూర్ణబలముతోను, నీ దేవుడైన ప్రభువును ప్రేమింపవలె ననునది ప్రధానమైన ఆజ్ఞ.
bible_verses.english: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.

bible_verses.telugu: ప్రభువా, మా దేవా, నీవు సమస్తమును సృష్టించితివి; నీ చిత్తమునుబట్టి అవి యుండెను; దానిని బట్టియే సృష్టింపబడెను గనుక నీవే మహిమ ఘనత ప్రభావములు పొంద నర్హుడవని చె
bible_verses.english: You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for you created all things, and by your will they were created and have their being.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, You alone are worthy of all my worship and praise. Today, I surrender my whole heart, mind, and strength to You. Teach me to seek Your face not only in times of song, but in every moment of my day. May my life bring You glory continually. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, You alone are worthy of all my worship and praise. Today, I surrender my whole heart, mind, and strength to You. Teach me to seek Your face not only in times of song, but in every moment of my day. May my life bring You glory continually. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: True worship comes from a heart completely surrendered to Jesus. When we sing "I will worship," we aren't just singing for a Sunday service, but choosing a lifestyle of wholehearted devotion. God alone is worthy of every breath, every effort, and every moment of our lives. As you lift your voice today, offer Him your entire heart, trusting that seeking Him daily is where true peace is found.
